soru: How long had Hasan driven the night bus?
tr: Hasan gece otobüsünü ne kadar süredir kullanıyordu?
kanit: Hasan had driven the night bus, line N7, for eleven years.

soru: What did the baker bring on Fridays?
kanit: There was the baker who started work at 2 a.m. and always brought Hasan a warm simit on Fridays.

soru: Why did the old man ride the bus every night?
tr: Yaşlı adam neden her gece otobüse biniyordu?
secenekler: His late wife used to drive that route
He couldn't sleep because of noise
kanit: My wife and I used to drive this route

secenekler: The old man's wife, who trained Hasan
kanit: "That was her," he said. "That was exactly her."

soru: Where did the old man sit after that night?
tr: O geceden sonra yaşlı adam nereye oturdu?
secenekler: In the front seat next to Hasan
He didn't ride the bus anymore
kanit: He sat in the front seat, next to Hasan, and they talked all the way through the empty city.
